notes.title: “Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack” Announced, COMING IN 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38409476/d9cd52cae741b78d81f6fc7a009d13a9da7bdeb4.jpg[/img]
An alchemy RPG “Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack” is to be released in 2025. 

This title is the definitive edition of the Atelier "Secret" series, with brand new content such as additional playable characters and story from “Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout” to “Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key.”

Furthermore, a release date announcement program of “Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe pack” has been scheduled for 4th August 2025 at 9pm JST (1pm BST / 2pm CEST). This program will reveal further details and new footage about the game.

“Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack” Teaser Site
https://atelier.games/secretdx/us/

Note: Screens are taken from an in-development build. Final product may differ from actual shown footage.

notes.title: Atelier Ryza 5th Anniversary! "Secret" series optimization update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38409476/9ea9b27c9aa7b54839302266cbf07c63d935b95d.png[/img]
To celebrate five years since the release of Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout, we have released various optimization updates for the “Secret” series!

[h3]■Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout[/h3]
Note: "Ver. 1.09" will be displayed on the SteamⓇ version's title screen.
- Fixed specific issues when played on Steam Deck™.
- Changed the keyboard and mouse control settings in the SteamⓇ version.
- Added an auto-save feature.
- Added an option to fast forward Fatal Drive.
- Added an option to fast forward event scenes.
- Added an option to auto-play text during event scenes.
- Added graphics settings to the Options menu.
- Made other minor adjustments.

Update on September 20th (FRI) 8 PM JST
*The title screen of the SteamⓇ version will display Ver. 1.10.
Fixed a bug where some option settings were not saved after applying update Ver. 1.09.
*After applying updates from Ver. 1.09, all option settings will be reset only during the first launch of the game

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121560/

- Fixed specific issues when played on Steam Deck™.
- Changed the keyboard and mouse control settings in the SteamⓇ version.
- Added the difficulty "Very Easy".
- Added an option to fast forward Fatal Drive.
- Added an option to fast forward event scenes.
- Adjusted the auto-play speed of text during event scenes.
- Added graphics settings to the Options menu.
- Made other minor adjustments.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257290/

[h3]■Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key[/h3]
Ver.1.7.0.0 (SteamⓇ)
Note: This will be displayed as Ver. 1.07 on the title screen.
- Fixed specific issues when played on Steam Deck™.
- Added the difficulty "Very Easy".
- Added an option to fast forward Fatal Drive.
- Added a new landmark: Kala's Tent
Note: Kala's Tent will be added as a landmark after visiting it once this update has been applied.

- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Koei Tecmo выпустила трейлер Atelier в честь 25-летия серии — анонс новой игры ожидается на Tokyo Game Show 2022
notes.notes: 16 сентября на Tokyo Game Show компания Gust может объявить о разработке новой игры из серии Atelier. В этом году франшизе исполняется 25 лет, и анонс придётся как нельзя кстати. Кроме того, Koei Tecmo America выпустила трейлер, приуроченной к юбилею.

notes.title: Миллион на двоих: Koei Tecmo рассказала о продажах JRPG-дилогии Atelier Ryza

notes.title: Малышка Райза вернулась: Обзор Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy
notes.notes: Одна из самых успешных частей в серии игр Atelier быстро получила достойное продолжение. Через три года после описанных в Atelier Ryza событий Рейзалин Стоут покинула свой родной остров Куркен, чтобы отправиться в столицу королевства. Здесь ее ждут не только повзрослевшие друзья, но и новые тайны, удивительные открытия и обаятельная магия алхимии. Кроме скромной поклажи из пары ножей и ложек, милашка Райза взяла с собой загадочный артефакт, похожий на яйцо, который напрямую связан с руинами забытой цивилизации. Именно исследованием этих заброшенных построек вы и будет заниматься большую часть игрового времени.

Thank you for purchasing Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy.
Please refer to the information below regarding a commonly asked question.

[h3]１：Issue concerning the proper resolution not displaying after selecting a resolution[/h3]
    The resolutions that are selectable via the Graphics Settings are dependent on the main display settings of the monitor that is being used.
    For dual monitors, if you are unable to select the highest resolution from the Graphics Settings, please check the main display settings.

Regarding graphics options, additional adjustments are planned to be gradually added via future patches.

notes.title: Regarding a question we have received many inquiries about
notes.notes:
Thank you for purchasing Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy.
Please refer to the information below regarding a commonly asked question.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3]１：Regarding changing the Screen Resolution or Full Screen & Borderless display settings[/h3]
　Please follow the steps listed below. 
　
　１．Launch the application and proceed to the title screen
　２．Select “New Game”
　３．After the Opening Event is finished, and you can freely control your character, press the Esc key
　４．Select the Graphics Settings

※For all users that have already started the game, pressing the Esc key when in the field will also cause the same menu to appear.

In addition, future adjustments will be made in order to allow for this Steam version exclusive menu to be accessible from the title screen.
We will post an update once these adjustments are complete.
